## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior and the affected component.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Distinguish fixture tests from a real owner-authorized attestation. If a relevant check could not run, explain the concrete limitation.

## Data and trust boundaries

Describe any change to collected data, SDK versions, signing or verifier configuration. Use synthetic examples and keep credentials, private responses and wallet signatures out of the pull request.
